title: 01 / Establish a healthy baseline
caption: Two healthy containers and a real customer request returning HTTP 200.

title: 02 / Introduce the bad port
caption: The override changes CATALOG_URL to catalog:9090. The HTML page still loads; the customer request fails.

title: 03 / Diagnose from evidence
caption: ECONNREFUSED points to catalog:9090. The same container can reach catalog:8081: the configured port is wrong.

title: 04 / Repair and verify Docker
caption: Recreate with the known-good configuration. Check readiness, three customer requests, and their fresh logs.

title: 05 / Establish the Kubernetes baseline
caption: The image is loaded into kind. Both Pods are ready; a request through the storefront Service succeeds.

title: 06 / Diagnose the unready Pod
caption: The bad ConfigMap takes effect after replacement. Running with 0/1 ready and zero restarts is a readiness failure.

title: 07 / Repair and verify Kubernetes
caption: Restore the ConfigMap and replace the Pod. Readiness, Service traffic, and fresh request logs now agree.
